instruction: Navigate to event 1 at /api/events/1. What is the event name?
Search events at /api/events?q=concert. How many total results?
Go to /api/stats. How many total events are there?
Filter events by category at /api/events?category=Music. How many events match?
Go to /api/users. How many users are registered?
Go to /api/tickets. How many tickets exist in the system?
Filter events at /api/events?date_from=2025-07-01&date_to=2025-12-31. How many total results?
Sort events by price at /api/events?sort=price. What is the first event name?
Compare events at /api/compare?ids=1,2. How many events are returned?
POST /api/login with username of the first user. Does it return user_id?
Export events at /api/export?format=csv. Does it return CSV data?
Get events by date range at /api/events/by-date-range?date_from=2025-06-01&date_to=2025-08-31. How many?
POST /api/wishlist with user_id=1 and event_id=1. Does it toggle the wishlist?
POST /api/promo/validate with code=SUMMER10. What is the discount percentage?
POST /api/orders with user_id=1, event_id that is on_sale, ticket_type and quantity=1. Does it create an order?
Cancel an order via POST /api/orders/{order_id}/cancel. Does it return cancelled status?
POST /api/register with username=testuser, display_name=Test User, email=test@test.com. Does it return 201?
PUT /api/users/1/settings with email_notifications=false. Does it update?
POST /api/feedback with event_id=1, message='Great event'. Does it return submitted status?
Search events semantically at /api/events/semantic?q=outdoor music summer. Does it return results?
